svg.title: JGDMS Full Security Architecture
svg.desc: Complete security architecture of JGDMS covering the five-host SCAP pipeline, BAE bytecode analysis, SPIFFE/SPIRE workload identity, three-layer policy stack, GrantPermission intersection, Subject two-identity model, proxy lifecycle, and DynamicPolicyProvider grant management.
svg.text: Five-host SCAP Pipeline · BAE · SPIFFE/SPIRE · JwtVerifier SPI · DiscoveryCredentialProvider · Three-Layer Policy Stack · GrantPermission · Subject API · SubjectAwareExecutor · Proxy Lifecycle · ReadReplicaVerdictRegistry · DynamicPolicyProvider
SCAP — Five-Host Safe Codebase Audit Pipeline (JGDMS-STD-002)
Validates bytecode safety before any proxy is unmarshalled
Passive registry · stores marshalled service items · no bytecode parsing
SELinux-isolated · runs 4 analyses per JAR · no outbound internet
Primary holds signing key · signs quorum results · ReadReplicaVerdictRegistry event-sourced read-replicas (WI57) · client VERDICT_CACHE TTL=300s (WI48)
Only host with outbound internet · proactive downloads · no BAE
Reactive · receives VirtualThreadPinned JFR events · no codebase access
⚠ Host 2 → Host 3: NO direct write path · Compromised BAE cannot forge verdicts
⚠ Host 4 ↔ Host 5: NO connection · JFR flood cannot DoS the download pipeline
Four analyses run on every JAR before a RegistryVerdict is issued
BFS from <clinit> to blocking sinks · carrier-pin DoS detection
Verdicts: CLEAN · BLOCKING_GUARDED · BLOCKING_DECLARED (→DANGEROUS) · NATIVE_OPACITY · CYCLE
Detects circular <clinit> dependency chains · deadlock prevention
Verdicts: If declared permission matches blocking sink guard → BLOCKING_DECLARED
className#action syntax prevents false positives (action-qualified guard matching)
X.509-SVID based ambient identity · no username/password login
Manages X.509-SVID Subject · streaming gRPC watcher · atomic AtomicReference<R>
Exponential backoff reconnect (1s→2s→4s→…→5min) · empty SVID keeps valid Subject
getTrustBundle() defensive copy · isCredentialValid() / secondsUntilExpiry() health API (WI49) · LocalPrincipalProvider registration on start()
Full certificate chain checkValidity() loop · not just leaf cert
Trust domain enforcement by default · cross-trust requires modification
Trust bundle parsed from X509SVID.bundle per SPIRE Workload API spec
Provides client cert from current SVID · supports TLS mutual auth
Pair with SpiffeX509TrustManager in JSSE SSLContext
SpiffeSubjectHolder wires SPIFFE ACC ProtectionDomains into AbstractLookupDiscovery operations
SPIFFE Subject NOT used via Subject.callAs (rejected) · DirtyChai ACC path only · NoOp default
Pluggable @FunctionalInterface in BasicInvocationDispatcher · exp/iat/iss/aud validation (no JWKS call needed)
JWT_VERIFICATION_CACHE ConcurrentHashMap (max 1024) · DefaultJwtVerifier built-in default · setJwtVerifier() for custom strategy
Each layer revokes independently · getPermissionGrants() flows up the stack
Issuer: any caller holding GrantPermission · via VerifyingProxyPreparer
Revocation: isVoid() true when domain GC'd · background VoidGrantSweeper
Single daemon thread sweeps every 60s · hot path remains read-only
No ReferenceQueue · no clearCache() on GC · hot path lock-free
Grant lifetime: djinn session · volatile PermissionGrant[] for lock-free reads
Issuer: InMemoryPolicyService administrator via replace(String[] grants)
Wire format: String[] (policy file syntax) · @AtomicSerial not needed
replace() validates: caller holds GrantPermission · grants hold PolicyPermission
replace() fires RemoteEvent → listeners pull getCurrentGrants() source of truth
Revocation: new replace() call · immediate replace of volatile array
Grant lifetime: JVM lifetime · refresh() called on SVID rotation
Source: HTTPS server with SPIFFE SVID client cert + CA pinning
Fail-secure: node will not start if bootstrap server unreachable
Grants: SPIRE socket · reach InMemoryPolicyService · minimal bootstrap only
RefreshingParserDecorator wraps parser to re-authenticate with fresh SVID
No single party controls the effective grant unilaterally
② What GrantPermission entries allow (RemotePolicyProvider ceiling)
③ What SPIFFE principal scope matches (DynamicPolicyProvider scoping)
= Effective dynamic grant scoped to this specific authenticated endpoint
Explicit path: Security.grant(proxy.getClass(), permissions) → hard SecurityException on failure
Principal[] param: null = preparing thread Subject · non-null = explicit SPIFFE scope
Must not appear in delegatable grants
Extends AbstractJiniService · implements RemotePolicyService JERI interface
replace() parses String[] via DefaultPolicyScanner.scanStream() · validates on server side
LandlordLease management · async PolicyUpdateEvent dispatch · SPIFFE admin SVID gate
Workload identity (ACC) + Human identity (ScopedValue) · additively merged
doAsPrivileged(spiffeSubject, action, acc) at service start
SpiffeCredentialManager installs updated Subject on SVID rotation
Lifetime: duration of Callable only (request-scoped, structured)
Cannot escape Callable boundary · structured identity
Daemon threads MUST NOT be spawned inside callAs scope
combine() calls getMergedPrincipals() on every checkPermission
Reads SCOPED_SUBJECT directly (trusted java.base) — no AuthPermission check
Additively merges ACC Subject principals + ScopedValue human principals
ScopedValue.isBound() checked before get() — null-safe hot path
Policy can condition grants on both workload AND human identity simultaneously
Policy grant requiring BOTH workload + human principal:
Wraps ExecutorService · captures Subject.current() + Security.getContext() at task submission
Restores on worker thread via AccessController.doPrivileged + Subject.callAs() for non-SPIFFE subjects
SPIFFE identity propagates via captured ACC only (Subject.callAs rejected for SPIFFE Subjects)
All lifecycle methods delegate to wrapped ExecutorService · use instead of bare pool to preserve identity
Prevents Subject loss across async pool boundaries · Subject.currentAll() support for merged subject sets
Bootstrap Trust Chain & DirtyChai Guard Inventory
Minimal local grant → SPIFFE SVID → bootstrap policy → full policy stack
Just enough to connect to local SPIRE agent
Connects to SPIRE workload API socket
Streams SVIDs via gRPC protocol (manual HTTP/2 + protobuf)
HTTPS connection using SVID client cert + CA pinning
Fail-secure: JVM will not start if unreachable
Authenticated by SPIFFE SVID on JERI wire
Downloads full operator policy grants via String[] wire format
Subscribes to PolicyUpdateEvent for live refresh
SecureClassLoader.defineClass() · WI62: Principal[]-aware overloads (byte[]+ByteBuffer) inject server SPIFFE principals into ProtectionDomain
ObjectInputStream.readOrdinaryObject() + readProxyDesc() (covers dynamic-proxy gadget chains — G-3)
depth guard limit = 7 · policy stack uses 3 · headroom 4
Six phases from service start to live ProtectionDomain grant
JoinManager: multicast → registers ServiceItem in lookup services
ServiceDiscoveryManager discovers lookup · registrarPreparer prepares registrar
ProxyCodebaseSpi: hash JAR SHA-256 → query Host 3 getVerdictByHash()
SAFE RegistryVerdict required · DANGEROUS or absent → refuse + alert
Quorum of BAE instances must agree · retry backoff 1s→2s→4s (3 attempts, WI45) · VERDICT_CACHE (TTL=300s) fallback on outage (WI48)
Cache key: (InvocationHandler, List<Uri> codebase, ClassLoader parent)
Path 1 boomerang: SERVICES_EXP hit → export ClassLoader · Path 2 self-unmarshal
Path 3 cached: CACHE hit (STRONG key / WEAK value / 60s TTL)
Path 4 new: PreferredClassLoader · Pack200 Semaphore(maxConcurrentJarLoads=4) (WI56) · INCONCLUSIVE → retainedInconclusiveLoaderGrants (WI46)
bootstrapProxyPreparer.prepareProxy() — SPIFFE mTLS via JERI constraints
SubjectDomainCombiner injects principals into every checkPermission
ProxyCodebaseSpi.resolve() provisions ClassLoader + unmarshals typed proxy
Constraints merged · proxy stored as filteredItem in LookupCache
AdvisoryDynamicPermissions from ClassLoader · intersect with GrantPermission ceiling
Security.grant(klass, perms) — scoped to SPIFFE principal of endpoint
WeakReference<ProtectionDomain> stored · auto-void on GC · DigestGrant binds local+server SPIFFE principals (WI61 — anti-hijacking)
GC-scoped per-proxy grants · wire-safe serial deserialization rules
isVoid() == true when domain.get() returns null (GC'd proxy)
VoidGrantSweeper daemon: single thread, every 60s by default
Hot path is read-only · no lock contention on grant lookups
No ReferenceQueue needed · ACC self-evicts before PD enqueue
refresh() triggers one-shot immediate eviction for admin cleanup
grant() enforces GrantPermission ceiling via Security.grant()
grant() scopes to caller's Subject SPIFFE principals by default
retainedInconclusiveLoaderGrants: RC.concurrentMap Ref.WEAK keys+values · ClassLoader-scoped grant tracking (WI46)
INCONCLUSIVE proxy: grant externally voidable via policy change · RC.concurrentMap self-cleans on ClassLoader GC
RULE-2: Public (GetArg) constructor — wire entry point
RULE-3: Static check(GetArg) called before any field set
RULE-4: All Object-returning GetArg.get() calls type-checked
RULE-5: serialForm() + serialPersistentFields for instance-field classes
Violations → DANGEROUS RegistryVerdict · codebase refused by all clients
Why String[] wire format: DirtyChai cannot implement @AtomicSerial
Signing includes sorted declaredPermissions for tamper evidence
SubjectDomainCombiner injects both · policy can require both simultaneously
ServiceUI JAR is independent codebase · separate BAE audit + RegistryVerdict
Declares permissions the JAR needs at runtime
JarAnalyzer reads non-blank, non-comment lines on every scan
If declared permission matches blocking sink guard → BLOCKING_DECLARED
Sorted permissions included in BAE engine signature (tamper evident)
GrantPermission ceiling in RemotePolicyProvider cross-references this list
